observations: Photo 0 shows the interior of a black wardrobe with two sections, each with a hanging rod and two drawers below.
Photo 1 shows the front of the same wardrobe with four doors and four drawers at the bottom.
The wardrobe appears to be made of wood or wood composite with a dark, glossy finish.
The doors have vertical metal handles; the drawers have horizontal metal handles.
There is visible wear and smudges on the surface, especially in photo 1.
The wardrobe is placed against a wall with tiled flooring.
No brand or model is visible on the item in either photo.

claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows four doors and four drawers; photo 0 confirms the drawer count and interior structure.

risks.risk: Structural damage or warping not visible in photos
risks.proof: A side view or video showing the edges, corners, and alignment of doors and drawers.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially unstable or misaligned

risks.risk: Drawer or door mechanisms not functioning properly
risks.proof: A video showing all doors opening/closing smoothly and drawers sliding in/out without sticking.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly non-functional or difficult to use

risks.risk: Hidden water damage or mold inside the wardrobe
risks.proof: A close-up photo or video of the interior back panel and bottom shelf, especially in corners.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially damaged or unsanitary

risks.risk: Surface damage or scratches not visible due to lighting or angle
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the entire front surface under direct light, showing all doors and drawers.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having possible surface defects

proof_requests: Video showing all doors and drawers opening and closing smoothly.
Close-up photo of the entire front surface under direct light to check for scratches or damage.
Side view or video showing the edges and alignment of the wardrobe.
Close-up of the interior back panel and bottom shelf to check for mold or water damage.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a 4-door wardrobe with 4 drawers, and the seller's claim is supported by the photos. Hidden risks exist but are common in second-hand furniture; the item can be priced at its worst case (with potential defects) based on visible condition and structure.
